text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Try to limit sugary drinks and fast food. Second, exercise regularly. Even a short walk every day can make a big difference. Third, get enough sleep, because your body needs rest to stay strong. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends, take breaks, and manage stress. Finally, keep a good work-life balance. Spend time on hobbies and with family. When you combine these habits, you feel happier, more energetic, and ready to enjoy life.
